predictions.text: I predict that the Albertan government will outline plans for addressing the referendum results, including any potential steps towards further consultation or legislative actions within the province, and these plans will include a proposal for a constitutional amendment process involving at least two provinces by the end of Wednesday, 28 October 2026.
I predict that the Saudi Civil Defense intercepts at least one missile aimed at a major city, likely Riyadh, by the end of Wednesday, 28 October 2026.
I predict that the Israeli-Palestinian conflict will continue with more arrests in the occupied West Bank, involving at least 5 additional people from different countries.

I predict that the defense will file an appeal, and the case will be sent to a higher court in the United States, with hearings starting by the end of Wednesday, 28 October 2026, in a different district.
I predict that the conflict in the Abyei area between South Sudan and Sudan will continue, with at least two more drone strikes reported in the region.
I predict that Andorra and San Marino will each hold a parliamentary session to approve the association agreements with the European Union on Monday, 26 October 2026.

I predict that the World Food Programme will cut monthly food aid for about 500,000 people in the Gaza Strip, reducing the number of recipients from 1.6 million to 1.1 million, and the situation will continue to worsen with ongoing cuts affecting primarily the northern Gaza cities.
I predict that the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft successfully reaches orbit around Phobos.
I predict that the legal challenges will not succeed in overturning the approval, and the maritime boundary agreement between Libya (GNA) and Turkey will remain in effect.
I predict that a prominent individual will receive a life sentence without the possibility of parole by a Kenyan court.
